notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Repeat.
